_comment: Open-source web apps that live in their own GitHub repositories. tools/update_store.py pins each one to the latest commit of its branch, lists the files a browser needs and writes them into store/catalog.json. CI refreshes this every day. Fields: id, repo, branch, root (subfolder), entry, include/exclude (glob patterns, relative to root), name, description, category, icon (file in the app or an emoji), color, internet (override the auto-detection), rename ({"file-in-repo": "name-the-page-expects"}, for upstream naming mistakes).

github.description: The original sliding-tile puzzle by Gabriele Cirulli: join the numbers and reach the 2048 tile. Plays with arrow keys or swipes.

github.name: Falling Blocks
github.description: Jake Gordon's classic falling-blocks game in a single HTML file with canvas graphics. Arrow keys to move and rotate.

github.name: Pong
github.description: Jake Gordon's take on the 1972 arcade classic, with sound effects and a computer opponent at several difficulty levels.

github.name: Vector Asteroids
github.description: Pure JavaScript asteroid-blasting arcade game with vector graphics and sound by Doug McInnes.

github.name: Fluid Simulation
github.description: Play with colourful, swirling fluids in your browser. A beautiful WebGL simulation by Pavel Dobryakov that also works on phones.

github.name: QR Code Generator
github.description: Type any text or link and get a QR code instantly, generated entirely in your browser with qrcode.js by davidshimjs.

github.name: Sudoku
github.description: Generate Sudoku puzzles at different difficulties, get hints with candidate numbers or let the solver finish it. Demo of robatron's sudoku.js.

github.name: Sketch Pad
github.description: A minimal drawing canvas with adjustable brush size and colour. From Brad Traversy's 50 Projects in 50 Days.

github.name: Password Generator
github.description: Create strong random passwords with your choice of length, upper/lower case, numbers and symbols, and copy them with one click.

github.name: Analog Clock
github.description: An elegant analog and digital clock with a light/dark theme toggle. From 50 Projects in 50 Days.

github.name: Drink Water
github.description: Track how many glasses of water you drank today toward your 2-litre goal with a filling cup.

github.name: Catch the Insect
github.description: Pick your favourite insect and catch as many as you can before they take over the screen. Insect pictures are loaded from the web.

github.name: Quiz
github.description: A small multiple-choice quiz with score at the end. Edit the questions in script.js to make your own.

github.name: Random Picker
github.description: Can't decide? Type your choices separated by commas, press Enter and let it pick one at random.

github.name: Sound Board
github.description: Six buttons, six sounds: applause, boo, gasp, tada, victory and wrong. Perfect for game nights.

github.name: Key Codes
github.description: Press any key to see its event.key, event.keyCode and event.code values. Handy for web developers.

github.name: Dad Jokes
github.description: A random dad joke at the press of a button, fetched from icanhazdadjoke.com.

github.name: Photo Cards
github.description: A gallery of expanding photo cards - click one to open it. Photos are loaded from Unsplash.
